mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vault_space WHERE del_flag = '0') AS totalSpaces, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM vault_space WHERE del_flag = '0') AS activeUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vault_replica r INNER JOIN vault_space s ON s.id = r.vault_id AND s.del_flag = '0') AS totalReplicas, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.device_id) FROM vault_replica r INNER JOIN vault_space s ON s.id = r.vault_id AND s.del_flag = '0') AS uniqueDevices, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vault_file f INNER JOIN vault_space s ON s.id = f.vault_id AND s.del_flag = '0' WHERE f.deleted = 0) AS totalFiles, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vault_file f INNER JOIN vault_space s ON s.id = f.vault_id AND s.del_flag = '0' WHERE f.deleted = 0 AND f.file_type = 'note') AS noteFiles, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vault_file f INNER JOIN vault_space s ON s.id = f.vault_id AND s.del_flag = '0' WHERE f.deleted = 0 AND f.file_type = 'asset') AS assetFiles, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vault_file f INNER JOIN vault_space s ON s.id = f.vault_id AND s.del_flag = '0' WHERE f.deleted = 0 AND f.file_type = 'config') AS configFiles, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(used_bytes), 0) FROM vault_space WHERE del_flag = '0') AS totalUsedBytes, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(dedup.size_bytes), 0) FROM ( SELECT r.asset_id, MAX(r.size_bytes) AS size_bytes FROM vault_asset_ref r INNER JOIN vault_space s ON s.id = r.vault_id AND s.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY r.asset_id ) dedup) AS assetBytes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT s.user_id FROM vault_space s LEFT JOIN vault_user_quota q ON q.user_id = s.user_id WHERE s.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY s.user_id, q.quota_bytes, q.expire_time HAVING COALESCE(SUM(s.used_bytes), 0) >= COALESCE( CASE WHEN q.expire_time IS NULL OR q.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN q.quota_bytes ELSE NULL END, #{defaultQuotaBytes} ) ) oq) AS overQuotaUsers

SELECT CAST(c.create_time AS DATE) AS day, c.op AS op, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM vault_change c INNER JOIN vault_space s ON s.id = c.vault_id AND s.del_flag = '0' WHERE c.create_time >= #{since} GROUP BY CAST(c.create_time AS DATE), c.op ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT s.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nick_name AS nickName, COUNT(s.id) AS spaceCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vault_replica r INNER JOIN vault_space s2 ON s2.id = r.vault_id AND s2.del_flag = '0' WHERE s2.user_id = s.user_id) AS replicaCount, COALESCE(SUM(s.used_bytes), 0) AS usedBytes, COALESCE( CASE WHEN q.expire_time IS NULL OR q.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN q.quota_bytes ELSE NULL END, #{defaultQuotaBytes} ) AS quotaBytes, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(s.used_bytes), 0) >= COALESCE( CASE WHEN q.expire_time IS NULL OR q.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN q.quota_bytes ELSE NULL END, #{defaultQuotaBytes} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overQuota FROM vault_space s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN vault_user_quota q ON q.user_id = s.user_id WHERE s.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY s.user_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, q.quota_bytes, q.expire_time ORDER BY usedBytes DESC, spaceCount DESC

SELECT s.id AS vaultId, s.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nick_name AS nickName, s.name AS name, COALESCE(s.used_bytes, 0) AS usedBytes, COALESCE(ut.user_used_bytes, 0) AS userUsedBytes, COALESCE( CASE WHEN q.expire_time IS NULL OR q.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN q.quota_bytes ELSE NULL END, #{defaultQuotaBytes} ) AS quotaBytes, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ut.user_used_bytes, 0) >= COALESCE( CASE WHEN q.expire_time IS NULL OR q.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN q.quota_bytes ELSE NULL END, #{defaultQuotaBytes} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overQuota, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vault_file f WHERE f.vault_id = s.id AND f.deleted = 0) AS fileCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vault_replica r WHERE r.vault_id = s.id) AS replicaCount, COALESCE( CASE WHEN q.expire_time IS NULL OR q.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN q.replica_limit ELSE NULL END, #{defaultReplicaLimit} ) AS replicaLimit, (SELECT MAX(c.create_time) FROM vault_change c WHERE c.vault_id = s.id) AS lastSyncAt, s.create_time AS createTime, s.update_time AS updateTime FROM vault_space s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN vault_user_quota q ON q.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COALESCE(SUM(used_bytes), 0) AS user_used_bytes FROM vault_space WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY user_id ) ut ON ut.user_id = s.user_id WHERE s.del_flag = '0'
AND (u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND COALESCE(ut.user_used_bytes, 0) >= COALESCE( CASE WHEN q.expire_time IS NULL OR q.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN q.quota_bytes ELSE NULL END, #{defaultQuotaBytes} )
AND COALESCE(ut.user_used_bytes, 0) < COALESCE( CASE WHEN q.expire_time IS NULL OR q.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN q.quota_bytes ELSE NULL END, #{defaultQuotaBytes} )
ORDER BY s.update_time DESC, s.id DESC

SELECT s.id AS vaultId, s.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nick_name AS nickName, s.name AS name, COALESCE(s.used_bytes, 0) AS usedBytes, COALESCE(ut.user_used_bytes, 0) AS userUsedBytes, COALESCE( CASE WHEN q.expire_time IS NULL OR q.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN q.quota_bytes ELSE NULL END, #{defaultQuotaBytes} ) AS quotaBytes, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ut.user_used_bytes, 0) >= COALESCE( CASE WHEN q.expire_time IS NULL OR q.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN q.quota_bytes ELSE NULL END, #{defaultQuotaBytes} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overQuota, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vault_file f WHERE f.vault_id = s.id AND f.deleted = 0) AS fileCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vault_replica r WHERE r.vault_id = s.id) AS replicaCount, COALESCE( CASE WHEN q.expire_time IS NULL OR q.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN q.replica_limit ELSE NULL END, #{defaultReplicaLimit} ) AS replicaLimit, (SELECT MAX(c.create_time) FROM vault_change c WHERE c.vault_id = s.id) AS lastSyncAt, s.create_time AS createTime, s.update_time AS updateTime FROM vault_space s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN vault_user_quota q ON q.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COALESCE(SUM(used_bytes), 0) AS user_used_bytes FROM vault_space WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY user_id ) ut ON ut.user_id = s.user_id WHERE s.id = #{vaultId} AND s.del_flag = '0'
SELECT config_key AS configKey, config_value AS configValue FROM sys_config WHERE config_key LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_config SET config_value = #{configValue}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE config_key = #{configKey}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT q.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.nick_name AS nickName, q.quota_bytes AS quotaBytes, q.replica_limit AS replicaLimit, q.max_file_bytes AS maxFileBytes, COALESCE( CASE WHEN q.expire_time IS NULL OR q.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN q.quota_bytes ELSE NULL END, #{defaultQuotaBytes} ) AS effectiveQuotaBytes, COALESCE( CASE WHEN q.expire_time IS NULL OR q.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN q.replica_limit ELSE NULL END, #{defaultReplicaLimit} ) AS effectiveReplicaLimit, COALESCE( CASE WHEN q.expire_time IS NULL OR q.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN q.max_file_bytes ELSE NULL END, #{defaultMaxFileBytes} ) AS effectiveMaxFileBytes, q.plan_name AS planName, COALESCE(ut.used_bytes, 0) AS usedBytes, COALESCE(ut.space_count, 0) AS spaceCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vault_replica r INNER JOIN vault_space s2 ON s2.id = r.vault_id AND s2.del_flag = '0' WHERE s2.user_id = q.user_id) AS replicaCount, q.expire_time AS expireTime, CASE WHEN q.expire_time IS NOT NULL AND q.expire_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS expired, q.remark AS remark, q.update_time AS updateTime FROM vault_user_quota q LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = q.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS space_count, COALESCE(SUM(used_bytes), 0) AS used_bytes FROM vault_space WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY user_id ) ut ON ut.user_id = q.user_id WHERE 1 = 1
AND (u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR q.plan_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY q.update_time DESC, q.user_id DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM vault_file WHERE deleted = 1 AND update_time < #{cutoff}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orphanCount, COALESCE(SUM(f.size), 0) AS orphanBytes FROM basics_file f LEFT JOIN vault_asset_ref r ON r.asset_id = f.id WHERE f.del_flag = '0' AND f.path LIKE '%/vault/%' AND f.create_time < #{cutoff} AND r.file_id IS NULL

SELECT f.id AS id, f.config_id AS configId, f.path AS path, f.size AS size FROM basics_file f LEFT JOIN vault_asset_ref r ON r.asset_id = f.id WHERE f.del_flag = '0' AND f.path LIKE '%/vault/%' AND f.create_time < #{cutoff} AND r.file_id IS NULL ORDER BY f.create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
